text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 灰色宽松粗针织青果领双排扣开衫，浅灰内搭，深灰黑水洗拼接工装阔腿牛仔裤，黑色尖头鞋。配饰：黑色窄框墨镜；银色圆环耳饰一对。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue image, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, realistic fabric/construction. Portrait 2:3; entire objects fully visible with comfortable margins. No text, watermark, people, skin, body parts, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, support or scene. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation, no skin-colored filling in stockings. Preserve exact visible color, silhouette, pattern and details. Conservatively reconstruct occluded details without adding decoration. The ONLY target is the 下排左 outfit in the reference (Chinese position; 上排左=top left, 上排中=top center, 上排右=top right, 下排左=bottom left, 下排中=bottom center, 下排右=bottom right, 左=left, 右=right, 整图=single outfit). Ignore every other panel. Create a coherent complete front-facing hollow outfit display. Garments and shoes: 灰色宽松粗针织青果领双排扣开衫，浅灰内搭，深灰黑水洗拼接工装阔腿牛仔裤，黑色尖头鞋. Exact detachable accessories inventory: 黑色窄框墨镜；银色圆环耳饰一对. Show each listed accessory exactly once (a pair only where specified), placed naturally or beside the outfit without overlap or cropping. No extra items. Keep the shirt neckline hollow; never show a body.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
